# Stylzo

> Free Unicode text generator. 5,616 styles across 18 categories, with 100 dedicated style pages.

Stylzo converts plain text into styled text by replacing letters with look-alike Unicode characters, not by applying a font. The result pastes into any app that accepts plain text. Typing example: "Stylzo".

## What it does
- Generates and copies text styles in the browser, with no account.
- Provides a searchable style index, 100 dedicated style pages and platform style guides.
- Includes symbols, emoji and kaomoji libraries with one-tap copy.
- Includes browser text tools: word counter, case converter, reverse, slug and find and replace.
- Includes an image compressor, text fixer, screenshot-to-text OCR, PDF page editor, PDF accessibility checker, QR code generator and QR code reader.
- Includes a font studio that renders styled text to a 1200x630 PNG in the browser.

## Important limits
- Output is Unicode characters, not an image or a font. Apps without the relevant glyphs render empty boxes; each style page states its support level.
- Styling runs entirely in the browser. Typed text is never sent to the server.
- Images, PDFs and QR code images are decoded and processed on the visitor's device, not uploaded.
- PNG compression is lossless, so a PNG can get larger instead of smaller. The tool reports the real byte change.
- There is no account and no sign-up.

## Pages
- [Main generator](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/): the tool. Supports ?text= and ?category=.
- [Font style index](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/fonts): all 100 styles by category. Supports ?q=.
- [Font style pages](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/fonts/bold): one page per style, with support notes and examples.
- [Style guides](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/styles): 25 words in 25 styles, plus 6 platform guides.
- [Instagram guide](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/styles/instagram): field limits, bio styles and FAQs.
- [TikTok font generator](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/tiktok-font-generator): field rules, limits and styles for TikTok.
- [Facebook font generator](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/facebook-font-generator): field rules, limits and styles for Facebook.
- [X font generator](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/x-font-generator): field rules, limits and styles for X.
- [YouTube font generator](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/youtube-font-generator): field rules, limits and styles for YouTube.
- [Telegram font generator](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/telegram-font-generator): field rules, limits and styles for Telegram.
- [Text tools](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/tools): word counter, case converter, reverse, slug and more.
- [QR code generator](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/qr-code-generator): codes for links, text, Wi-Fi, email, phone, SMS, WhatsApp, contacts, maps and events.
- [QR code reader](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/qr-code-reader): read a QR code from an image without uploading it.
- [Image compressor](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/image-compression): compress JPG, PNG and WebP in the browser with the real before-and-after size.
- [Text fixer](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/universal-text-fixer): repair spacing, punctuation, invisible characters, capitalisation, repeated words and common misspellings.
- [Screenshot to text](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/screenshot-to-text): recognise text from an image in a Web Worker, then edit or replace a line.
- [PDF editor](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/pdf-editor): reorder, rotate, duplicate, merge and stamp PDF pages without uploading the document.
- [PDF accessibility checker](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/pdf-accessibility-checker): check tags, language, title, fonts, alt text, links and form labels.
- [Font studio](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/studio): styled text to a 1200x630 PNG.
- [Symbols](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/symbols), [Emoji](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/emoji), [Kaomoji](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/kaomoji): copyable libraries.
- [About](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/about) and [Privacy](https://www.abdulsamad.shop/privacy).

## Style categories
Bubble and boxed (1205), Italic (964), Small and tiny (723), Bold (482), Cursive (482), Gothic (482), Clean (482), Outline (241), Wide (241), Decorated (65), Flip and reverse (49), Emoji (48), Glitch (31), Gaming (30), Social (29), Lines (26), Symbols (22), Kaomoji (14)
